headline: Craft your time.
support: Create beautiful timetables, schedules and planners in minutes. For classes, work, study and everyday life.
featuredBody: Use this course table maker to place lectures, labs, and discussions on a weekly grid. Add times yourself or import View My Courses from UBC Workday, then check the classes you want on the timetable.
excelHowTitle: How to get the Excel from Workday
excelHow3: Under the “View My Courses” title, click the first icon — the one to the left of the PDF icon. That downloads the Excel file.
howTitle: How to make a class timetable
how1b: Enter course codes, days, times, and rooms. UBC students can also import a Workday Excel file; the file is read in this browser tab only.
how2b: Select which courses appear on your weekly schedule. Adjust colors and the timetable title, then check the grid for overlapping classes.
how3b: Download a PNG of the timetable card, or an .ics file for Google, Apple, Outlook, and Samsung Calendar.
privacyBody: Schedules stay in this browser until you reset them. Workday remains the source of record; always confirm times there.
seoTitle: Timetable Maker – Free Online Schedule & Planner Tool
seoDescription: Free timetable maker online. Build a class timetable, weekly schedule, study planner, exam timetable or work schedule in minutes, then export PNG or calendar.
useTitle: A course table maker for the way you plan
manualTitle: Build a weekly class schedule manually
manualBody: No spreadsheet? Add each course with meeting days, start and end times, and location. See lectures and labs together on one weekly timetable. Winter and Summer term groups are included; sections and credits are optional.
ubcTitle: UBC schedule maker with Workday import
ubcBody: Already have a UBC course schedule? Import the View My Courses Excel export to keep details and meeting patterns together. Switch Winter and Summer terms and choose whether to show active, waitlisted, or dropped sections.
tmTitle: A free online timetable maker for every kind of schedule
tmBody: TimetableCraft is a free timetable maker that runs in your browser. Make a class timetable, school timetable, weekly schedule, study timetable, exam timetable or work rota. Start from an editable template, adjust the blocks, then download a PNG, print a PDF, or add it to Google, Apple or Outlook Calendar. No account, and nothing is uploaded.
ha1: A timetable maker is an online tool that lays classes, shifts, study sessions or exams out on a weekly or daily grid. TimetableCraft lets you add events, pick colors and export the result as a PNG, a printable PDF or a calendar file.
ha2: Yes. Every timetable maker on TimetableCraft is free, needs no sign-up and has no watermark. Your plan is stored only in your browser.
hq3: How do I make a timetable online?
ha3: Choose a tool, add a starter template or click an empty slot to add your first event, set the day and time, then edit titles and colors. Export when it looks right.
hq4: Can I put my timetable on my phone or calendar?
ha4: Yes. Download the PNG to use as a phone wallpaper, or export an .ics file and open it in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook or Samsung Calendar.
